name: Lisle Summer 2023
information:
This competition is in series with [Evanston Summer Big Cubes 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerBigCubes2023) and [Evanston Summer Side Events 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerSideEvents2023). You will only be allowed to compete in one of these three competitions.

Please read all tabs before registering. At the competition, rounds will start early whenever possible, so please prepare to compete up to 15 minutes before the scheduled start of each round.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
